name: buckley-medium-15
original:
update(agents): restrict source-extractor to caller-named files only

- Restrict the source-extractor agent's tool allowlist to read_file, removing search_text since repository discovery is the caller's responsibility
- Rewrite the agent prompt to forbid scope expansion: read only caller-named files, never widen caller ranges or substitute anchors, and follow next_start_line only within caller scope and budget
- Clarify that missing paths/anchors or unread ranges mean an incomplete result, not permission to expand scope
- Add a test asserting the resolved one-shot execution tool filter is exactly read_file and submit_artifact
- Update prompt assertions to cover the new scope rules and ban obsolete search/pagination wording
